items.why: Iran stepped up attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, pushing Brent above $101 and lifting yields and the dollar. About $546M in leveraged crypto longs got liquidated and spot ETFs saw outflows.

market_note: Fed September meeting minutes due later today; traders watching for hints of another rate hike.
summary: Stocks are pulling back from record highs as Treasury yields climb to a 24-year high and oil tops $100. The Dow is off about 500 points, with small caps taking the worst of it.
